lines.en: label mollyinvite1:
I tap on Molly’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Molly 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: And I do this knowing that at least Ami is going to be present today.
lines.zh: 而我这么做的时候心里清楚，至少今天 Ami 会在场。

lines.en: But hey, having her encounter the various girls I invite over to the house is practically tradition at this point.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，让她撞见我往家里请的各路女孩，到这会儿已经算是传统了。

lines.en: And while it very well may be a tradition that will ultimately wind up with someone dying, it’s a tradition nonetheless.
lines.zh: 虽说这传统最后很可能会以某个人死掉收场，但它终究还是个传统。

lines.en: Now please excuse me as I put Molly’s life in jeopardy for at least the second time since I have met her.
lines.zh: 那么请容许我——至少是认识她以来第二次——把 Molly 的小命置于险境。

lines.en: : Well met, traveler! ‘Tis I — Molly MacCor-
lines.zh: : 幸会，旅人！正是我——Molly MacCor——

lines.en: : I know who you are, Molly. I needed to tap on your name in order to call you. That is how phones work on planet Earth.
lines.zh: : 我知道你是谁，Molly。我得点你的名字才能打给你。地球上的电话就是这么用的。

lines.en: : Aye. ‘Tis strange to think that once upon a time you’d have needed to pry my name from the clutches of ye olde rolodex. To what do I owe the pleasure though, Sir? Has fair Arborea’s phone departed this mortal coil?
lines.zh: : 是。想想从前，您还得从那古老的名片夹里把我的名字撬出来，真是不可思议。不过这份荣幸从何而来，先生？是美丽的 Arborea 的电话已经仙逝了吗？

lines.en: : No. I just wanted to hear your voice and remind you that I care for and appreciate you.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是想听听你的声音，顺便提醒你——我在乎你，也很看重你。

lines.en: : Okay, but what do you really want?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那您真正想要的是什么？

lines.en: : Nothing in particular.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。

lines.en: : You want to do ecchi stuff, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 您是想做点色色的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure. So long as you’re fine with Ami joining in.
lines.zh: : 是啊。只要你不介意 Ami 也一起。

lines.en: : Mo-
lines.zh: : Mo——

lines.en: : Hold on. I’m deliberating.
lines.zh: : 等等。我正在权衡。

lines.en: : Molly, I was kidding. I was just wondering if you wanted to come over and do...whatever it is you like to do.
lines.zh: : Molly，我开玩笑的。我只是想问你要不要过来，做点……你喜欢做的事。

lines.en: : But...Sir! The things {i}I{/i} like to do only make you want to punt me. It’s why I try to avoid you on Tuesdays as server resets compel me to speak about things you’d never-
lines.zh: : 可是……先生！{i}我{/i}喜欢做的事，只会让您想一脚把我踢飞。所以我才尽量在周二躲着您——因为服务器重置会逼我说些您永远——

lines.en: : I’m bored. Do you want to just watch a movie or something?
lines.zh: : 我好无聊。要不干脆看个电影什么的？

lines.en: : FFFFFF- This is exactly what I mean! Why lead me on like this?!
lines.zh: : FFFFFF——我说的就是这个！您为什么要这样吊我胃口？！

lines.en: : The movie thing was a joke. I’m fully prepared to endure whatever sort of nerdy, geeky, and/or otaku stuff you want to force upon me today. I promise.
lines.zh: : 看电影是开玩笑的。今天您想硬塞给我的任何宅、极客、和/或御宅族玩意儿，我都做好心理准备承受了。我保证。

lines.en: : But...{i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是……{i}为什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Do you think this is a trap?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这是陷阱吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Cool. Then be at my place in an hour.
lines.zh: : 很好。那一小时后到我家。

lines.en: : Sir! I-
lines.zh: : 先生！我——

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and...I know what you’re thinking. “Sensei, you’re so manly and cool. What could have possibly compelled you to do such an uncharacteristically lame thing?”
lines.zh: 我挂断电话……我知道你们在想什么。「老师，您这么有男人味又这么酷，到底是什么驱使您做出这种反常的窝囊事？」

lines.en: Well, the answer to that is simple.
lines.zh: 嗯，答案很简单。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv1
Molly’s cute and I want to put my penis inside of her.
lines.zh: Molly 很可爱，我想把我的鸡巴放进她里面。

lines.en: And going along with the things she wants to do sometimes feels like the {i}least{/i} I can offer in exchange for the real estate that is her lower body.
lines.zh: 而偶尔顺着她的意思做点她想做的事，感觉是我能为她下半身那块地皮付出的{i}最低{/i}代价了。

lines.en: : Molly? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Molly？你怎么在这儿？

lines.en: Just kidding. I simply want her to be happy.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。我只是想让她开心。

lines.en: {i}I’m not kidding about wanting to put my penis inside of her, though.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过想把鸡巴放进她里面这件事，我可没开玩笑。{/i}

lines.en: : Top ‘o the...evening, Ami! As unexpected and unbelievable as it may sound, the Supreme Overlord has summoned me here to engage in gaming and/or anime and/or cosplay with him!
lines.zh: : 晚……晚上好，Ami！虽然听起来既意外又难以置信，但至高霸主召我前来，是要和他一起打游戏、和/或看动漫、和/或玩 cosplay！

lines.en: : Ha-ha. Now tell me why you’re really here.
lines.zh: : 哈哈。那说说你真正来这儿的原因吧。

lines.en: : She’s telling the truth.
lines.zh: : 她说的是实话。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv2
: She’s {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 她说{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : For some reason that I dare not question, the Herald of the Adolescents has seen the light and wishes to learn more about my way of life!
lines.zh: : 出于某种我不敢追问的理由，青春传令官终于看见了光，想要更多地了解我的生活方式！

lines.en: : I was kind of hoping your midlife crisis would be more along the lines of wanting to cuddle with your daughter all day long...but I guess I can live with this too?
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望你的中年危机会是想整天搂着女儿那种……不过这样我好像也能接受？

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forget you’re {i}also{/i} uncool sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了你有时候{i}也{/i}挺不酷的。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv3
: I don’t need to be cool! I’m cute! Teehee!
lines.zh: : 我不需要酷！我可爱就行！嘻嘻！

lines.en: : Firstly, there is nothing {i}uncool{/i} about engaging in gaming and/or anime and/or cosplay! That is a dated outlook, Sir.
lines.zh: : 首先，打游戏、和/或看动漫、和/或玩 cosplay 一点都不{i}丢人{/i}！那是过时的看法，先生。

lines.en: : Secondly, however, is there something specific you {i}wanted{/i} to do?
lines.zh: : 其次，您有什么特别{i}想{/i}做的吗？

lines.en: : Or are we but seconds away from the rug being pulled out from underneath mine legs, leaving me sobbing and wishing for death on the kitchen floor?
lines.zh: : 还是说再过几秒，我脚下的地毯就要被抽走，留我一个人趴在厨房地板上抽泣、恨不得死了算了？

lines.en: : I mopped today, so at least you’ll die clean.
lines.zh: : 我今天拖过地了，所以至少你死的时候是干净的。

lines.en: : No murder in the house, Ami. And Molly, why don’t we just play that game you girls are always playing together? You seem to enjoy that enough and I’ve shrugged it off in the past, so-
lines.zh: : 家里不许杀人，Ami。还有 Molly，我们要不就玩你们几个女生总在一起玩的那个游戏？你看起来挺喜欢的，我以前也都当没看见，所以——

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv4
: Hooooold on! Surely you jest, Sir! One does not simply walk into Mordor. There are preparations that must be made. Stories that must be carefully crafted and...all sorts of other things!
lines.zh: : 等、等等！先生您一定是在开玩笑！那可不是说走就能走进魔多的。得先做准备。故事要精心编织，还有……各种别的事！

lines.en: : Why that, Dad? If you really wanted to learn, you could have just asked me.
lines.zh: : 干嘛非要那个，爸爸？你要真想学，直接问我不就行了。

lines.en: : I’m just struggling to think of anything else Molly likes as it all sort of blends into this weird soup of Japanese culture that I’m surprised Molly even knows about.
lines.zh: : 我只是想不出 Molly 还喜欢什么别的——那些东西全混成了一锅奇怪的日本文化浓汤，我甚至惊讶 Molly 居然还懂这些。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv5
: Dungeons and Dragons is from the states, Sir. It isn’t Japanese at all.
lines.zh: : 《龙与地下城》是美国来的，先生。跟日本一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Then maybe I’m just secretly American and want to feel a slice of home again.
lines.zh: : 那也许我其实是个美国人，只是想再感受一点家乡的味道。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, we {i}are{/i} pretty culturally American in like a million different ways. I wonder why?
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我们在文化上{i}还真{/i}有一百万个方面都很美国。真不知道为什么？

lines.en: : No clue. But anyway, let’s play. I may never feel this generous again.
lines.zh: : 不知道。总之，开始玩吧。我可能再也不会这么大方了。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv6
: Sir, we can’t! You don’t even have a character yet!
lines.zh: : 先生，不行！您连角色都还没有呢！

lines.en: : Don’t you have like a trillion premade ones, though? Can’t he just use one of those while you...run some campaign from a book or something?
lines.zh: : 可你们不是有一大堆现成的角色吗？他就随便拿一个用，你……照着书跑个战役什么的，不行吗？

lines.en: : I could always just {i}make{/i} a character. I can’t imagine it takes very long.
lines.zh: : 我也可以直接{i}造{/i}个角色。我想应该花不了多少时间。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv7
: I can’t even begin to explain how many problems I have with that statement, Sir.
lines.zh: : 先生，您这句话里有多少问题，我都不知从何说起。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv8
: But it matters not! For character creation is arguably the best part of the experience and one that I’m not inherently inclined to believe you’ll utterly despise!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为创建角色可以说是这整个体验里最棒的部分，而且我本能上并不认为您会彻底讨厌它！

lines.en: : Yay! Everyone wins. Except for my daddy who will probably still kind of despise it.
lines.zh: : 耶！皆大欢喜。除了我爸爸——他大概还是会有点讨厌。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv9
: I...I’d heard that the relationship between the two of you was leveling up, but...hearing you address the Supreme Overlord in such fashion is...a bit more jarring than I expected.
lines.zh: : 我……我听说过你们俩的关系在升级，但……听您这样称呼至高霸主，还是……比我预想的更冲击。

lines.en: : Hahah! You should hear how I say it in my dreams.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！您该听听我在梦里是怎么叫的。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv10
So anyway, we’re here now. And I’m only a little bit in over my head.
lines.zh: 总之，我们现在到这一步了。而我只是稍微有点力不从心。

lines.en: It’s a type of drowning I’m prepared for, though. And not just because I’m the one who threw myself off the bridge and into the water, but because it...well, it could be {i}fun.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过这是一种我早有准备的溺水。不只是因为是我自己从桥上跳进水里的，还因为……嗯，它可能会{i}很好玩{/i}。

lines.en: I think I need that — something to bond with people over that isn’t just...literally hovering over them.
lines.zh: 我想我需要这个——某种能和人建立联系的东西，而不只是……字面意义上地压在他们身上。

lines.en: Frankly, I’ve probably needed something like that for quite some time. I’ve just never been as acutely aware of how true that is until right now due to how quiet it’s become inside of my head.
lines.zh: 说实话，我大概已经需要这样的东西很久了。只是因为脑子里变得太安静，我才第一次如此真切地意识到这一点。

lines.en: But hey, if I’m good enough at this game, maybe Molly will let me borrow one of the voices inside of hers.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果我这游戏玩得够好，也许 Molly 会愿意把她脑子里的某个声音借给我一个。

lines.en: : Now! There are several different ways in which we can tackle this, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那么！我们有几种不同的处理方式，先生。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv11
: When it comes to crafting a character, there are many questions to be asked. What race do you prefer? Is there a particular class you’re interested in? Where do you come from? What are your goals?
lines.zh: : 说到捏角色，要问的问题可多了。您喜欢什么种族？有没有特别感兴趣的职业？您来自哪里？您的目标是什么？

lines.en: : And while I don’t expect you to have the answer to all of them right away-
lines.zh: : 虽然我没指望您能立刻回答全部——

lines.en: : I want to be a bird-man warrior from Tokyo who kills the demon lord.
lines.zh: : 我要当个来自东京的鸟人战士，专门去杀魔王。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv12
: Or you have {i}all{/i} of the answers already and they’re {i}all{/i} incorrect. I don’t know why I expected any less.
lines.zh: : 或者您已经把{i}所有{/i}答案都想好了，而且{i}全都{/i}是错的。我也不知道自己为什么还抱期待。

lines.en: : Maya plays a bird-man. {i}That’s{/i} not why you’re suddenly interested in this game, is it?
lines.zh: : Maya 玩的就是个鸟人。您突然对这个游戏感兴趣，不是{i}因为这个{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Just one of many unfortunate coincidences that involve the two of us. Just tell yourself I’m learning so I can be closer to my daughter.
lines.zh: : 只是我们俩之间众多不幸巧合中的一个。您就当我是为了能离女儿更近一点才学的吧。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv13
: Easy! That’s already how I rationalize practically everything.
lines.zh: : 简单！我本来就是这么给几乎所有事找理由的。

lines.en: : Sir, if you’re serious about being an Aarakocra, which is the D&D equivalent of “bird people,” I’ll mark it down.
lines.zh: : 先生，如果您是认真的，我就把您记成 Aarakocra——也就是 D&D 里的「鸟人」。

lines.en: : I’d urge you to at least {i}look{/i} at the other options first though, so you can be sure that what you’re choosing is right for you.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是建议您先{i}看看{/i}别的选项，好确认自己选的确实适合您。

lines.en: : Well, what other options are there? I didn’t even realize being a bird-person was possible. I was just naming stuff.
lines.zh: : 那还有什么别的选项？我都不知道还能当鸟人。我刚才只是随口瞎编。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv14
: Oof. Where do I even begin? In terms of traditional fantasy that normies like you would be familiar with...you’ve got elves, dwarves, orcs, gnomes, humans, half-orcs, half-elves, halflings-
lines.zh: : 呃。这从哪儿说起好呢？就拿你们这种普通人熟悉的经典奇幻来说吧……有精灵、矮人、兽人、侏儒、人类、半兽人、半精灵、半身人——

lines.en: : Why are there so many halves? That last one just sounded derogatory.
lines.zh: : 为什么有这么多「半」？最后那个听起来简直像骂人。

lines.en: : That’s what Ayane plays. They’re these weird mini-people. You’d like them because reasons.
lines.zh: : Ayane 玩的就是那个。是一种奇怪的小矮人。你会喜欢他们的，原因嘛……

lines.en: : I don’t like the implications of that, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这话里的暗示，Ami。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv15

: In terms of {i}less{/i} traditional fantasy if you’re feeling a bit more exotic, there are races like...aarakocra, tabaxi, kobolds, aasimar, tieflings, the warforged, and even this race of turtle people called tortles.
lines.zh: : 要是想来点{i}不那么{/i}经典的、更异域一点的，还有这些种族……aarakocra、tabaxi、狗头人、aasimar、tiefling、warforged，甚至还有一种叫 tortle 的龟人。

lines.en: : That’s just “turtles” but slightly mispelled.
lines.zh: : 那不就是「turtles」（乌龟）稍微拼错了嘛。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv16
: Right you are, Sir! And this is nowhere close to even {i}half{/i} of the official playable races in 5e!
lines.zh: : 您说得对，先生！而且这连 5e 官方可选种族的{i}一半{/i}都不到！

lines.en: : And while each one comes with their own set of racial advantages, certain races are better at certain jobs or roles than others.
lines.zh: : 虽然每个种族都有自己的种族加成，但某些种族在特定职业或定位上会更强。

lines.en: : Many people, myself included, like to use a character’s race as the starting point for character building as the majority of them provide some sort of base-level fantasy to jump off of.
lines.zh: : 很多人——包括我——喜欢把种族当作捏人的起点，因为大多数种族都能提供某种基础的幻想框架供你展开。

lines.en: : But if the race itself is not important to you, it’s perfectly fine to work backwards as well! And seeing as you don’t really know about any of them yet, why not first ask yourself {i}what{/i} you want to do with-
lines.zh: : 不过如果您不在乎种族，反过来从别的开始也完全没问题！既然您现在还都不了解，不如先问问自己想用它来做——

lines.en: : Hey, sorry to interrupt, but does anyone want coffee?
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，有人要咖啡吗？

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv17
: Ah! A new challenger approaches!
lines.zh: : 啊！新的挑战者出现了！

lines.en: : Yeah, my bad. I was planning on waiting for you to finish your speech, but I had a feeling I was going to be standing here for the next year or two and the warmer only stays on for an hour.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不好意思。我本来打算等您讲完的，但我有种预感——我得在这儿站上一两年，而保温盘只开一个小时。

lines.en: : It’s not what it looks like, I swear.
lines.zh: : 不是看上去那样，我发誓。

lines.en: : You mean you’re {i}not{/i} making a D&D character with two teenage girls right now?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你现在{i}不是{/i}在跟两个十几岁的女孩捏 D&D 角色？

lines.en: : That’s right. I’m here to seduce them.
lines.zh: : 没错。我是来勾引她们的。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv18
: Is seducing teenagers really more acceptable in your eyes than engaging in stereotypically nerdy conduct?
lines.zh: : 在您眼里，勾引未成年少女真的比做那种刻板印象里的宅事更容易接受吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I’m a cool guy. And I need to remain a cool guy to keep up my awesome cool guy image.
lines.zh: : 是的。我是个酷哥。而我必须继续当酷哥，才能维持我那超赞的酷哥形象。

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} Those who are born as normies ultimately {i}die{/i} as normies. This is presumably naught more than a temporary phase for the Supreme Overlord here. But one I must indulge regardless!
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。生为凡人者，终将{i}死{/i}为凡人。对这位至高霸主来说，这大概不过是一个暂时的阶段。但无论怎样，我都得顺着他！

lines.en: : Also, I like your shirt.
lines.zh: : 另外，我喜欢你的衬衫。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv19
: Thank you! I relate to her on a level that not many understand. I like your hair.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！我跟她在某种很少有人懂的层面上很有共鸣。我喜欢你的头发。

lines.en: : Thank you! It’s...red.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！它是……红色的。

lines.en: : Yes.
scene mollyfirstinv20
: In regard to the whole “normie” thing, though, let me just say...this guy wasn’t {i}always{/i} as lame and uninteresting as he is right now.
lines.zh: : 不过关于「凡人」那件事，我只想说……这家伙{i}以前{/i}可不像现在这么无趣、这么没劲。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv21
: As a matter of fact, the two of us were {i}both{/i} pretty huge dweebs back in the day.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我们俩当年{i}都{/i}是相当大的书呆子。

lines.en: : Yay! Flashback story! I can’t wait to not be in it because Dad didn’t love me yet!
lines.zh: : 耶！回忆杀！我都等不及要缺席了——因为那时候爸爸还不爱我！

lines.en: : What...do you mean exactly?
lines.zh: : 你……具体是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean he and I used to hang out in my room watching mech shows and playing Dragon Quest all day.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，他和我以前整天待在我房间里看机甲动画、玩《勇者斗恶龙》。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv22
: YOU WHAT?!?!?!?!
scene mollyfirstinv23
: Oh, great. Here we go.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。来了。

lines.en: : THE SUPREME OVERLORD HAD AN OTAKU PHASE AND I NEVER KNEW ABOUT IT?!
lines.zh: : 至高霸主曾经有过一段御宅时期，而我居然从来不知道？！

lines.en: : THIS IS VITAL INFORMATION THAT HAS BEEN KEPT FROM ME FOR REASONS UNKNOWN! IT IS INCONCEIVABLE! IT IS UNFORGIVABLE!
lines.zh: : 这是被以未知理由对我隐瞒的重要情报！不可理喻！不可饶恕！

lines.en: : Why does she keep calling him the “Supreme Overlord?” Is this a chuuni thing?
lines.zh: : 她为什么一直叫他「至高霸主」？这是中二病吗？

lines.en: : Molly’s entire personality is a chuuni thing. Also, you should hear the second half of that title. That part’s even {i}more{/i} interesting.
lines.zh: : Molly 整个人就是个中二病。而且你该听听那个称号的后半段。那部分{i}更{/i}有意思。

lines.en: : It certainly is not. And we certainly {i}will{/i} not be talking about anything Niki and I did in her bedroom when we were children.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。而且我们当然{i}不会{/i}聊我和 Niki 小时候在她卧室里做过的任何事。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv24
: Yeaaaah...that’s probably for the best.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……那样大概最好。

lines.en: : I...am suddenly much more interested in this flashback.
lines.zh: : 我……突然对这段回忆感兴趣多了。

lines.en: : ME TOO! BUT MY RAGE OVERRIDES MY CURIOSITY!
lines.zh: : 我也是！但我的愤怒压过了我的好奇心！

lines.en: : Why didn’t you ever tell me, Sir? You don’t feel guilt over your childhood interests, do you? Because if it’s a matter of merely growing up-
lines.zh: : 您为什么从来没告诉过我，先生？您不会因为小时候的兴趣感到愧疚吧？如果只是因为长大了——

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just don’t really {i}remember{/i} any of it. Everything from back then is...still kind of blurry to me.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。我只是真的不太{i}记得{/i}了。那时候的一切……对我来说还是有点模糊。

lines.en: : I could probably bring those memories back if I try hard enough. I might still even have one of our old save files on a memory card back at my parents’ place.
lines.zh: : 如果我够努力，也许能把那些记忆找回来。说不定我爸妈那儿还留着一张记忆卡，里面有我们以前的存档。

lines.en: : Yeah, so about what you and Aunt Niki did when you were kids-
lines.zh: : 对啊，那你和 Niki 阿姨小时候做过的事呢——

lines.en: : Sorry. Can’t remember that either.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。那个我也不记得了。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv25
: Heeeeeey...
: {i}Yes,{/i} Ami?
lines.zh: : {i}怎么了{/i}，Ami？

lines.en: : Story please?
lines.zh: : 讲讲嘛？

lines.en: : Mmmmmm...
: I’ll tell you when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 等你长大点再告诉你。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv26
: Aaaaaaah! Why is it okay for me to hear you guys going at it from across the house but {i}not{/i} okay for me to hear about the way you explored when you were little?! I need to know!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！为什么我隔着整栋房子听你们干那件事就可以，却{i}不能{/i}听你们小时候是怎么探索的？！我必须知道！

lines.en: : Ami, go to your room.
lines.zh: : Ami，回你房间去。

lines.en: : WE’RE ALREADY HERE!
lines.zh: : 我们已经在这儿了！

lines.en: : Mech shows...Dragon Quest...
lines.zh: : 机甲动画……《勇者斗恶龙》……

lines.en: : I can’t believe I never knew...
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信我居然从来不知道……

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv27
: All this time, we had that thread in common...just obscured by the passage of time and the onset of shame. But...for what?
lines.zh: : 这么久以来，我们一直有那条共同的线牵着……只是被时间的流逝、以及随之而来的羞耻遮住了。可……为了什么？

lines.en: : Uh-oh. I think your friend might be on the verge of having an existential crisis, Ami.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我觉得你这位朋友可能就要闹存在主义危机了，Ami。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m {i}always{/i} on the verge of having one of those- so that’s one {i}more{/i} thread we have in common.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可{i}一直{/i}都处在那种危机的边缘——所以这{i}又{/i}是我们共同的一条线。

lines.en: : Just let her ride it out. Sometimes, time is the best medicine for-
lines.zh: : 让她自己消化吧。有时候，时间是最好的药——

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv28
: That settles it!
lines.zh: : 就这么定了！

lines.en: : Or not.
lines.zh: : 也可能不定。

lines.en: : Settles what? Did you finish my character without me? Did I beat the game?
lines.zh: : 定什么？你背着我捏完我的角色了？我通关了？

lines.en: : No! Your character has been scrapped! Because, in the words of Illidan Stormrage, YOU ARE NOT PREPARED!
lines.zh: : 不！您的角色已经被废弃了！因为，用 Illidan Stormrage 的话说——你们还没准备好！

lines.en: : But I’ll tell you what, Sir! I will not sit idly by as you gaze upon the days of your youth as if they were a dark place that you should feel ashamed of!
lines.zh: : 但我跟您说，先生！我不会袖手旁观，看着您把青春岁月当成一处该感到羞耻的黑暗之地！

lines.en: : Boy, do I have bad news for you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我这儿可有个坏消息要告诉你。

lines.en: scene mollyfirstinv29
: Save it! Speak not of your darkest days, for Molly MacCormack will show you the light!
lines.zh: : 省省吧！别提您最黑暗的日子，因为 Molly MacCormack 会为您指明光明！

lines.en: : ...Not to be confused with the light Yasu is always speaking of, though. A new light! One that shines favorably upon your childhood affinities and shows you there is naught to be ashamed of!
lines.zh: : ……不过别跟 Yasu 老挂在嘴边的那个「光」搞混了。是一种新的光！它会眷顾您童年的那些爱好，让您明白没有什么好羞耻的！

lines.en: : You can still enjoy what you once loved! You’re not too old for games, Sir! Age is just a-
lines.zh: : 您依然可以享受曾经热爱的东西！您玩游戏的年纪不算大，先生！年龄不过是个——

lines.en: scene black
: So! About that coffee-
lines.zh: : 那么！关于那杯咖啡——

lines.en: Niki breaks up the conversation before it can spiral any further out of control and...potentially invoke something or...{i}someone{/i} I don’t want to be here right now.
lines.zh: Niki 打断了这场对话，没让它进一步失控，也……避免了可能招来某样东西，或者{i}某个{/i}我现在不想在场的人。

lines.en: Molly goes back to Ami’s desk, removing a laptop from her bag and taking the next ten minutes to try and figure out which Dragon Quest I apparently played when I was younger.
lines.zh: Molly 回到 Ami 的书桌前，从包里掏出一台笔记本，接下来的十分钟里一直试图弄清我小时候到底玩的是哪一作《勇者斗恶龙》。

lines.en: And while she doesn’t press me any further on the contents of my past {i}outside{/i} of that, she makes it clear that she has a new mission now.
lines.zh: {i}除了{/i}这个，她没有再追问我过去的任何细节，但她明确表示，自己现在有了新的使命。

lines.en: She wants to turn me back into a loser.
lines.zh: 她想把我变回一个废物。

$ molly_love += 1
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
